successCriteria.description: The private `addMonths` method is removed from `BalanceService` — `grep -rn "private addMonths" src/modules/balance/` returns no matches.

`carryForward` computes `nextPeriodEnd` via the shared `addMonths(source.periodEnd, policy.accrualPeriodMonths)` import, producing a value identical to the removed private method for the same inputs (same UTC day/month clamping behaviour).
`npm run build` completes cleanly and the existing test suite passes with no behavioural change.

constraints: Edit ONLY src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts. Do not touch the shared date module, repositories, routes, or DTOs.
Do not change the arithmetic or the `getUTC*` accessors — the shared `addMonths` logic must remain byte-for-byte equivalent to the removed private method.
Do not add any cross-module import beyond extending the existing `../../shared/date` import to include `addMonths`.
outOfScope: Any change to the shared date module (`src/shared/date/accrual.ts` / `index.ts`), repositories, routes, or DTOs.
Any behavioural change to `carryForward`, `openPeriod`, `getCurrentBalances`, or other service methods — this is a pure move.
Adding any other cross-module import or refactoring beyond the single `addMonths` import extension.

entityInvariants.invariant: The service exposes the same public interface (`IBalanceService`) and the same `carryForward`/`openPeriod`/`getCurrentBalances` behaviour after the move; only the private `addMonths` helper is removed in favour of the shared import.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `addMonths` function used by `carryForward` must be the shared implementation re-exported from `src/shared/date/index.ts` (originating in `src/shared/date/accrual.ts`), not a local reimplementation.

The `carryForward` method's observable behaviour (validation errors, transaction boundaries, `nextPeriodStart`/`nextPeriodEnd` computation, carry cap, create-vs-update decision) must remain unchanged.

integrationPoints.why: The service now consumes the shared `addMonths` function instead of its private copy, eliminating duplication.
